Job Description - Full Stack Developer (.NET / React / TypeScript)

Role: Full Stack Developer

Experience: 5-10 Years

Location: Pune

Job Summary

We are looking for a talented Full Stack Developer with strong experience in React, TypeScript, and .NET to build scalable, high-performance web applications. The ideal candidate will have expertise across both frontend and backend development, experience working in Agile environments, and a strong understanding of modern web architectures, testing frameworks, and CI/CD practices.

Key Responsibilities



Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack web applications using React, TypeScript, and .NET. Build responsive and reusable UI components using modern frontend frameworks and best practices. Develop and consume RESTful APIs and microservices. Collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving activities. Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure application reliability. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. Follow Agile development methodologies and software engineering best practices. 

Mandatory Skills

Frontend

Strong proficiency in React.jsStrong experience with TypeScriptHands-on experience with React RouterExperience building scalable and reusable component-based applicationsKnowledge of responsive web design and frontend performance optimization

Backend

Strong development experience with .NET Core / ASP.NET CoreExperience developing REST APIs and MicroservicesUnderstanding of backend architecture and security best practices

Testing & Development Practices

Experience with:Unit TestingIntegration TestingEnd-to-End TestingStrong proficiency in Git Version ControlExperience with CI/CD pipelinesGood understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies

Good to Have Skills

Experience with Server-Side Rendering (SSR)Knowledge of Node.js and Express.jsExperience with Next.js or RemixKnowledge of Tailwind CSSExperience working with Nx Monorepo ArchitectureExposure to modern testing frameworks such as:VitestPlaywrightTesting LibraryMSW (Mock Service Worker)
Technical Environment

The application ecosystem leverages modern web technologies, including:

ReactTypeScriptReact Router.NET CoreMicroservices ArchitectureNode.js / Express.jsTailwind CSSNx MonorepoVitestPlaywrightGitCI/CD Tools

Preferred Candidate Profile

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Ability to work in a fast-paced Agile environment. Experience working on enterprise-scale digital transformation projects. 

Primary Skills: React, TypeScript, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Microservices

Secondary Skills: Node.js, Express.js, SSR, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Nx, Playwright, Vitest, CI/CD, Git, Agile Scrum.

We have two business divisions: product and consulting.  
simulationHub is our flagship product and the manifestation of our vision. Currently, thousands of users use our CFD app in their upfront design process.

Debug and troubleshoot issues across UI and backend layers.
